answer:
**Total late fine as of 30 Nov 2026: ₹5,500**【SQL】.

| Component | Days overdue | Fine |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| tuition_inst1 | 108 | ₹5,000【SQL】 |
| exam | 30 | ₹500【SQL】 |

The fine for the tuition instalment follows the policy of **₹100 per day, capped at ₹5,000 per component**【Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4】, and the examination fee carries a **flat ₹500** fine【Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4】. Summing the two component fines gives the total late fine of **₹5,500**【SQL】.
sql: WITH overdue_fees AS (SELECT fl.component, fl.amount_due, fl.amount_paid, fl.due_date, (CAST('2026-11-30' AS DATE) - fl.due_date) AS days_overdue, CASE WHEN fl.component = 'exam' THEN 500 ELSE LEAST((CAST('2026-11-30' AS DATE) - fl.due_date) * 100, 5000) END AS fine FROM fee_ledger AS fl JOIN students AS s ON fl.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2026CS012' AND fl.status = 'overdue') SELECT component, amount_due, amount_paid, due_date, days_overdue, fine, SUM(fine) OVER () AS total_late_fine FROM overdue_fees ORDER BY due_date LIMIT 50
